concerns.text: The dependency mapping references an FR‑009 (checksum handling) that does not exist in the specification; this is a stale tag.
Task T004 validates against `contracts/entropy.schema.yaml` but there is no task that validates the complementary metadata contract `contracts/entropy_schema.schema.yaml` required by the data model.
Task T007 validates against `contracts/stat_results.schema.yaml` yet no task validates the alternative schema `contracts/statistical_result_schema.schema.yaml` defined in the contracts directory.
FR‑006 requires that all statistical findings be explicitly framed as associational; no task explicitly documents or enforces this framing in the generated report.
Constitution principle VI mandates a low‑motion robustness re‑analysis (mean FD < 0.2 mm). Task T012 only re‑runs the full pipeline and does not perform the required low‑motion subset analysis.
